title: Superman and the cat in the tree.
lines: Long ago, on a faraway planet, a baby was born.
The planet was breaking apart.
His parents put him in a little spaceship.
They sent him to Earth.
The spaceship landed on a farm.
A kind farmer and his wife found the baby.
They called him Clark.
They looked after him as if he were their own child.
Clark grew up among the cows and the cornfields.
But Clark was different from other children.
He could lift a tractor with one hand.
He could run faster than a train.
And he could see through walls.
His mum said: You have great powers, Clark.
Always use them to help others.
When Clark grew up, he went to live in the city.
He worked at a newspaper.
He wore glasses and a tie.
Nobody knew his secret.
But when help was needed, Clark quickly slipped away.
He put on his blue suit, with a red cape and a big S.
Then he was Superman.
Superman could fly!
High above the houses, through the clouds.
One afternoon, with his super hearing, he heard a girl crying.
My kitty!
My kitty is up in the tree!
Superman flew there.
High in a tree sat a little grey kitten.
It was miaowing.
It didn't dare come down.
Superman floated slowly up to the kitten.
Come on, little one.
I won't hurt you.
The kitten jumped into his arms.
Superman floated down and gave the kitten to the girl.
Thank you, Superman!
But then Superman heard something else.
A train!
The tracks were broken and the train was heading straight for them.
Superman flew as fast as the wind.
He stood in front of the train.
He pushed with his hands.
The train stopped.
Just in time.
The people on the train got off and clapped.
The next day Clark was sitting at his desk as usual.
With his glasses on.
His colleague Lois was reading the newspaper.
Yesterday Superman rescued a kitten and stopped a train.
What a hero.
Clark smiled.
Yes, he said.
But the kitten was the most important.
The end.
